References / Poster / 526

Poster for a Risograph demo

A two-color poster that announces a Risograph demonstration, printed in red and blue with hand-drawn lettering and a drawing of the machine.

Source
Flickr: lee leblanc, “risograph”
Creator
Unknown. The Flickr uploader, lee leblanc, does not say who designed it.
Made
2015 (photographed 23 December 2015)
Style
Risograph (agent-proposed, not yet reviewed by a person)
Moods
Handmade, playful, informal
Evidence
Viewed the 1024 × 765 px Flickr “large” file, a photograph of two copies taped to a wall. The poster names the event (“Monday Nov 30, 6–7 pm”) but not the venue or designer.
Reviewed
2 October 2026
Rights
Link and metadata only. License: unverified. Rights policy

Context

Posted on Flickr under CC BY 2.0 with the description “see what it can do!”. The designer is not named.

Observed

  • Only two inks appear: a warm red for the title, the machine drawing, and one line, and a blue for the date and script words.
  • “Magic! Mystery Delight!” is written in blue script over the red drawing of the duplicator.
  • The paper is white, and both copies look the same, as in a short duplicator run.

Why it belongs

The poster advertises the machine with its own look: two drums, hand-drawn type, and a drawing of the duplicator.

Borrow

Let a script word in the second ink cross a drawing in the first ink.

A growing catalogue of visual references. Rights and removal
